name: Hollywood Sign
scope: Current hillside letterforms and supports, with individual letter terrain anchors; do not reconstruct the earlier HOLLYWOODLAND sign.
era: surviving exterior represented by selected dated references

references.caption: The Hollywood Sign, shot from an aircraft at about 1,500' MSL.

references.filename: View from behind Hollywood Sign overlooking LA.jpg
references.caption: Taken from atop Mt. Lee showing the back of the Hollywood Sign. From left to right, the view includes the Griffith Observatory, downtown Los Angeles, Hollywoodland subdivision (near/below), the sprawl of Los Angeles, Lake Hollywood. Taken on January 6, 2019.
references.sourceFamily: commons:view from behind hollywood sign overlooking la.jpg

review.method: Inspected both full local original photographs individually: the 2009 Jelson25 aerial front and Michael E. Arth 2019 rear panorama.
review.notes: The front establishes custom block letter forms, proportions and staggered heights; the rear shows separate panels, ladders, vertical posts and horizontal steel framing. Previously selected unrelated photos remain rejected. Dimensions, individual alignment and terrain anchors require separate research.
